lessons.title: The gradient
lessons.outcome: You change one weight by hand and see what the gradient tells you.

lessons.title: Using the gradient
lessons.outcome: TorC's optimizer changes the parameters. You see what the learning rate, momentum and zero_grad() do.
lessons.code:
optim::SGD opt({&W, &b}, /*lr=*/0.05f);
loss.backward();   // fills W.grad, b.grad
opt.step();        // W -= lr * W.grad, same for b
opt.zero_grad();   // clear before the next backward

lessons.title: Tensors
lessons.outcome: A tensor is a block of numbers with a shape. You see how shapes combine in broadcasting and in matrix products.

lessons.title: Layers
lessons.outcome: A linear layer is a matrix product plus a bias. You see its shapes, its gradients and the start values of its weights.
lessons.code:
nn::Linear layer(784, 32);   // W (32, 784), b (32)
Variable y = layer(x);       // x (B, 784) → y (B, 32)

lessons.title: Nonlinearity
lessons.outcome: Two linear layers in a row are still one linear layer. An activation function such as ReLU changes that.
lessons.code:
Variable h = relu(z);                 // max(0, z)
Variable s = sigmoid(z);              // 1 / (1 + e^-z)
Variable p = softmax(z, /*axis=*/1);  // each row sums to 1

lessons.title: Modules
lessons.outcome: A model is a set of parameters and a forward() function. Sequential puts layers in a row.

lessons.title: Losses
lessons.outcome: The loss measures how wrong the model is. Mean squared error is for numbers, and cross-entropy is for classes.
lessons.code:
nn::MSELoss mse;                      // regression
nn::CrossEntropyLoss ce;              // classification
Variable loss = ce(logits, labels);   // logits (B, 10), labels (B)

lessons.title: The training loop
lessons.outcome: A data loader splits the data into batches. Each step trains on one batch, and one pass over all batches is one epoch.

lessons.title: Better optimizers
lessons.outcome: Momentum, Adam and AdamW change each step in different ways. You compare them in the same narrow valley.

lessons.title: Generalization
lessons.outcome: A model can fit its training data and still fail on new data. Weight decay helps to prevent this.

lessons.title: Digits with an MLP
lessons.outcome: TorC trains a network with three layers on handwritten digits. You draw a digit and see what it reads.

lessons.title: Convolution
lessons.outcome: A small kernel slides across the image. The stride and the padding set the size of the output.

lessons.title: Digits with a CNN
lessons.outcome: A small convolutional network recognizes the same digits with a third of the parameters.

lessons.title: Backprop lab
lessons.outcome: Run small computations forward and backward, and see where each gradient comes from.
